source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 from the quadratic character of GF(337). The base array has entry 1 at row x and column y when x + y is a nonzero square modulo 337 and 0 when it is a non-square; the 337 cells with x + y = 0 are left free. 192 of the 337 columns were chosen by simulated annealing over column swaps, with each pattern on five columns left uncovered by the base rows weighted by the inverse of the number of free-cell choices that can cover it (programs/subselw.c, seed 2, 1,500,000 moves, temperature 0.5; the chosen columns are programs/sub_A.txt). A simulated annealing search over the free diagonal cells and 8 added rows (programs/ls2m.c, seed 1, 35,363,840 moves, temperature 0.35) left 163 patterns uncovered. An exact repair that flips single cells anywhere in the array and keeps exact incremental lists of uncovered and uniquely covered patterns (programs/repi.c) then ran in four stages: seed 21, temperature 0.35, 1 thread, to 4 uncovered; seed 31, 0.22, 1 thread, to 3; seed 41, 0.2, 2 threads, to 1; seed 77, 0.2, 2 threads, to 0. programs/run_recipe.sh runs every step and checks the sha256 of each stage against the original files. Exact check with ca_verify, all 5-sets
construction: Cyclotomic (quadratic character) array for q = 337 restricted to 192 columns chosen by weighted simulated annealing, with its diagonal cells and 8 added rows chosen by simulated annealing and exact single-cell repair
notes: one row below the cited size 346 at k = 192; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
